original:
अज्ञातवासं चरतां पाण्डवानां महात्मनाम् ।
विराटनगरे वासो धर्मराजस्य धीमतः ॥
sanskrit:
अज्ञातवासं चरतां पाण्डवानां महात्मनाम् ।
विराटनगरे वासो धर्मराजस्य धीमतः ॥
transliteration:
ajñātavāsaṃ caratāṃ pāṇḍavānāṃ mahātmanām |
virāṭanagare vāso dharmarājasya dhīmataḥ ||
translation: During the year of secret incognito exile, the magnanimous Pandavas took up residence in the realm of King Virata under disguised identities.

layers.author: gita_press
layers.content: अज्ञातवास के कठिन समय में महामना पाण्डवों और धीर धर्मराज युधिष्ठिर ने राजा विराट के नगर में छद्म वेश में निवास किया।

layers.author: traditional
layers.content: अज्ञातवासाच्या काळात महात्म्या पांडवांनी आणि धर्मराज युधिष्ठिरांनी राजा विराटाच्या नगरात गुप्त वेषात वास्तव्य केले.

layers.author: km_ganguli
layers.content: The thirteenth year represents the supreme test of patience and mastery over the senses where each Pandava served in humble disguise.

layers.author: bori
layers.content: Virata Parva highlights the transition from forest asceticism back to heroic self-defense during the Matsya cattle raid.
